'''''Ancient Life Day''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The painting depicted a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] elder with a staff, holding a [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] orb as if it were a [[Lantern/Legends|lantern]]. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Ancient Life Day'' was supplied during the 2007 Wookiee Life Day festivities.
